# Shipping static sites

Static hosting is **fast** and cheap. Read the [getting started guide](https://example.com/docs/start) first.

## Steps

- Build the site
- Upload the output
- Point your domain

Questions? See [the FAQ](https://example.com/faq/) or [another site](https://other.example/page).

```
appz deploy --prod
```
